coordinate_system.space: Blender world space of OW_Terrain (object transform is identity)
coordinate_system.godot_gltf_conversion: Godot position = Vector3(x, z, -y) when using the default glTF +Y-up export

terrain_grid.vertex_formula: x = origin[0] + grid_i * spacing, y = origin[1] + grid_j * spacing
terrain_grid.triangulation: cell (i,j): diagonal v00-v11 when (i+j) even, v10-v01 when odd

direction: samples and drainage_cells are ordered upstream (source) -> downstream (mouth/junction)
sample_spacing_meaning: target arc-length distance between consecutive samples; last segment may be shorter

width_meaning.bed_half_width: HALF width of the flat carved bed (terrain == bed_z inside it)
width_meaning.outer_half_width: HALF width where carving fades to zero (terrain untouched beyond)
width_meaning.wet_half_width: HALF width where the carved bank rises to water_z; left/right bank points use it

cross_section_profile.formula: z(dist) = ground - (ground - bed_z) * w; w = 1 if dist <= bed_half_width else 1 - smoothstep((dist - bed_half_width) / (outer_half_width - bed_half_width)); smoothstep(t) = 3t^2 - 2t^3; dist is perpendicular distance to the centerline
cross_section_profile.ground: pre-carve terrain height; ground_z_pre is the value at the centerline
cross_section_profile.combination: per terrain vertex the minimum over all samples/rivers is applied

water_surface_policy: Flat across each cross-section at water_z; water_z is non-increasing downstream; water_z = min(previous water_z, bed_z + 0.62 * depth). Build the surface from left/right bank points at water_z and clip against the terrain.

sample_format.overbank: true when water_z exceeds pre-carve ground (lake/spill)

drainage_cells_format: [grid_i, grid_j] of the original D8 drainage route used to build the centerline
source: carving samples from the generator; no texture/albedo/mask color detection is involved
